## Problem and behavior

What concrete problem does this change solve? Describe the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. For native changes, include the device/emulator and the affected user flow.

## Compatibility and limits

Mention relevant API/data migrations, original-photo handling, owner boundaries, or limitations. Include screenshots when they help review.

- [ ] Scope is focused and documentation is updated where behavior changes.
- [ ] No secrets, signing keys, private photos, or real collection exports are included.
- [ ] Meaningful validation is recorded above; unrun checks are identified.
